post.description:
Rotate the refresh token and get a new 15-minute access token.

Mobile sends `refresh_token` in the body; the portal (`X-Client: web`) relies on the httpOnly cookie.
A token read from the cookie is always answered through the cookie. Presenting the token rotated out
last signs the device out (`refresh_reused`).

Args:
    body: the refresh token (mobile) or nothing (web).
    request: the incoming request (cookie and `X-Client`).
    response: the outgoing response (new cookie for web).
    session: database session.

Returns:
    A new session; the old refresh token is now invalid.

Raises:
    UnauthorizedError: no or unknown token, signed-out device.
    RefreshReusedError: reuse of a rotated token.

head.description:
Answer HEAD /v1/healthz without touching any dependency.

This is the phones' reachability probe (plan §13 A1, 3 s timeout before every sync run). It must not
depend on S3 or the DB: a slow S3 would make every phone think it is offline and stop pushing
entries, and a deep check per probe would multiply backend load on a public route.

Returns:
    An empty 200 response.

post.description: Sends up to 50 entries (and at most 256 KB) captured offline, in capture order. Kinds: `event_version` (body `EventVersionIn`, the same as `CorrectionIn.data`), `quality_reading`, `plot`, `consent`; `flag_resolution` is rejected with `not_implemented_pilot` in the pilot. Each entry is its own transaction and gets its own result: `accepted`, `duplicate` (same `client_id` already stored by you; returns the original `server_id` and fresh upload URLs for photos not yet uploaded) or `rejected` with an error (`validation_error`, `client_id_conflict`, `stale_version`, `forbidden`, `not_found`, `reason_required`, `undo_window_closed`, ...). The response is 200 whenever the envelope parses. Photos are never in the push: each photo gets one presigned PUT (15 minutes, `Content-Type` and `x-amz-checksum-sha256` must be sent as given), then `POST /v1/sync/photos/confirm`. `metrics[]` rows are stored for the sync-health dashboard.
